Dublin–Rosslare Main Line History [ edit ] Seapoint station as viewed from the Martello Tower when it first opened. The station opened on 1 July 1862 and was originally called Monkstown & Seapoint, though the following year this was changed to just Seapoint. [ 1 ] It was upgraded and electrified in 1984 with the arrival of DART services. Transport services [ edit ] There is no direct public transport to or from the station. The nearest bus stops are on Monkstown Road, located 450 m from the station, which are served by the following: Dublin Bus Routes: 7 / 7A from Mountjoy Square to Bride's Glen / Loughlinstown .
